settings.heading: Artisan Crochet for the Modern Soul.
settings.subheading: Discover modern handmade slow fashion, bespoke tops, textured tote bags, and heirloom amigurumi toys. Each item is hand-stitched loop by loop in Jaipur using 100% natural organic cotton yarn.

settings.heading: Shop by Category
settings.description: Each collection is designed for conscious living, pairing timeless crochet motifs with contemporary silhouettes.

settings.heading: Every loop tells a story.
settings.text_1: Our pieces are carefully crocheted by hand, one stitch at a time. In a world of fleeting fast-fashion, we believe handmade products should feel personal, timeless, and special.
settings.text_2: By supporting our collective, you provide sustainable, dignified work for women artisans across Rajasthan, preserving heritage textile crafts for future generations.

settings.heading: Why Choose Maison Crochet
settings.description: We focus on craftsmanship over mass production, bringing thoughtful artisanal quality to your everyday wardrobe.

settings.heading: Have a specific idea in mind? Let's crochet it together.
settings.text: From custom bridal shrugs and heirloom baby blankets to specific colorways for your home, our studio artisans craft one-of-a-kind bespoke commissions.

settings.heading: Join the Maison Circle
settings.text: Subscribe to receive invitations to private seasonal drops, behind-the-scenes artisan workshop updates, and ₹200 off your first order.
